About your Coach

 Although your coach is certified in a number of areas, 
she has gone through many life's experiences of her own.  
This also enables her to help you move forward on paths where she has once been.
Sherée Bergman
Click on the name above for more information.
Sherée is the founder and facilitator of Heart to Heart Life Coaching LLC located in the Chicagoland area.

She is an Empowerment Coach and coaches in the areas of
Marriage/Relationship/Family Restoration,
 Emotional Healing, Personal Productivity and Life Purpose.
Sherée also works with Abused Women.

The Holy Spirit has led Sherée, through years of training,
to a blended and effective coaching style from all that she has learned and lived.

BELOW ARE THE TYPES OF SESSIONS WE OFFER
PHONE APPOINTMENT
ZOOM/FACETIME APPOINTMENT
We coach with Love

1 Corinthians 13:13
New International Version (NIV)
13 And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love. 

1 Corinthians 13:2
2 If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, 
and if I have a faith that can move mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.

1 John 4:16
16 And so we know and rely on the love God has for us.
God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.


Coaches at Heart to Heart Life Coaching LLC are NOT Licensed Professional Counselors 
and do NOT do counseling nor are they Mental Health Providers. 
They do NOT make diagnoses of any physical or mental health issues. 
They are Christian coaches who pray for a person's needs 
from a spiritual perspective based on the teachings of the Bible.
Counseling focuses on looking in the "rearview mirror"
​and Life Coaching focuses on looking through the "windshield".  
However, occasionally coaches do have to direct you to the rearview mirror to help you move forward.
